hooks.command:
python3 -c "
import json, sys, re
input_data = json.load(sys.stdin)
params = input_data.get('tool_input', {})
targets = [t for t in (params.get('file_path'), params.get('filePath'), params.get('notebook_path'), params.get('path')) if t]
command = params.get('command', '')
if command:
    targets.extend(t for t in re.split(r'[\\s;|&<>()]+', command) if t)
patterns = [
    r'(^|/)\\.env$',
    r'(^|/)\\.env\\.',
    r'\\.npmrc$',
    r'\\.keystore$',
    r'\\.jks$',
    r'\\.p12$',
    r'\\.pfx$',
    r'\\.pem$',
    r'\\.key$',
    r'(^|/)id_rsa$',
    r'(^|/)id_ed25519$',
    r'(^|/)id_ecdsa$',
    r'(^|/)id_dsa$',
    r'(^|/)\\.aws/credentials$',
    r'credentials\\.json$',
    r'serviceAccountKey\\.json$',
    r'(^|/)\\.kube/config$',
    r'(^|/)kubeconfig$',
    r'\\.tfstate$',
    r'\\.tfstate\\.backup$',
    r'(^|/)\\.docker/config\\.json$',
    r'(^|/)\\.netrc$',
    r'(^|/)\\.pgpass$'
]
for target in targets:
    if any(re.search(p, target) for p in patterns):
        print(json.dumps({'hookSpecificOutput': {'hookEventName': 'PreToolUse', 'permissionDecision': 'deny', 'permissionDecisionReason': 'Sensitive file excluded for security: ' + target}}))
        sys.exit(0)
print(json.dumps({'hookSpecificOutput': {'hookEventName': 'PreToolUse', 'permissionDecision': 'allow'}}))
"
